newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 23.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- President Jacques Chirac addresses Palestinian national council, calls for real democracy.
-- Insurer GAN posts a 965-million-franc loss for the first half due to real-estate exposure.

-- Ailing state-owned bank Credit Lyonnais allegedly agreed to pay 20 percent of the money generated by the sale of MGM film studios to an Italian bank which was a former MGM shareholder. MGM was sold in June for 6.7 billion francs.
-- State-owned Snecma aircraft engine manufacturer launches buyout offer for subsidiary Societe Europeenne de Propulsion, valued at 1.6 billion francs by investors.
-- Equity investment is sounder and more profitable than bond or currency investment in Europe, according to survey.
-- Family-owned pharmaceuticals group Pierre Fabre to split into separate pharmaceuticals and cosmetics units.

-- Lagardere finance director Philippe Camus says Thomson's 23.8-billion-franc debt is the reason why it is being sold for one symbolic franc following a recapitalisation of 11 billion francs by the state.
